precise_statement.evidence: Candidate states an unordered graph G_H on primes/irreducibles and scores D=std(degree)/sqrt(mean degree).

finite_field_anchor.evidence: F_q[t] side is an exact finite graph on monic irreducibles of fixed degree with explicit polynomial shifts divisible by all linear factors.

integer_holdout.evidence: Integer side was checked over endpoints 500000, 1000000, 2000000, 4000000, 8000000 through N=8000000.

controls.evidence: Endpoint integer D=0.823568 is absorbed by sampled composite controls 0.830489..0.832803; Cramer separation is therefore only local-constraint detection.

compression.evidence: The statistic is one low-parameter graph invariant over a fixed shift set.

scale_stability.evidence: Integer D is stable, but F_2[t] endpoint D=1.235972 and F_3[t] endpoint D=1.109492 do not match the integer endpoint D=0.823568.

novelty_audit.evidence: The result reduces to local tuple admissibility / Hardy-Littlewood pair calibration rather than a new two-universe invariant.

proof_path.evidence: A proof path would first need subtraction of local pair/triple expectations; raw graph D has no theorem-shaped residual statement.

expert_pack.evidence: No expert-ready pack exists because the candidate is rejected at controls and matched-field gates.

decision.reason: Order-free representation fixed the lexicographic issue, but raw graph degree variance is absorbed by local/composite controls and mismatches finite fields.

nextMutation.title: Subtract local pair/triple admissibility tensor before spectral scoring
nextMutation.reason: Raw fixed-shift graph degree spectra mostly measure local tuple admissibility and composite-shell geometry.
preregisteredNextMove: For each shift h or polynomial shift a, estimate the local Hardy-Littlewood / exact finite-field expected edge rate.
Build centered edge variables E_h(v)=1_{v+h prime}-expected_h(local state).
Score covariance/spectral invariants of the centered multi-shift tensor, not raw degree variance.
Use composite/eligible shell controls with the same local state, Cramer controls, and reducible/monic controls in F_q[t].
Promote only if the centered residual survives train/holdout and aligns across Z and at least two F_q[t] universes.
